title: RadioCraft
description: RadioCraft adds a placeable internet radio block that streams MP3 over HTTP, a station editor, volume/range, and activation modes (right‑click, redstone, always on). Audio plays on the client only.
body:
RadioCraft is a Forge 1.16.5 mod that adds a Radio block for streaming MP3 over HTTP (e.g. public internet radio).

Features:

Craft the Radio and Radio Editor (see recipes / JEI).
Place the radio and right‑click with the Radio Editor to open settings.
Set a stream URL (MP3), volume (0–100%), hearing range (1–64 blocks), and reconnect / loop behavior when the stream drops or ends.
Activation: right‑click toggle with empty hand, redstone, or always on when a URL is configured.
Note: playback is client‑side only; the server stores settings and syncs them to nearby players.

Requirements: Minecraft 1.16.5, Forge 36.x, Java 8 (runtime).

License: MIT.
Disclaimer: You are responsible for copyright and broadcaster terms — the mod only plays URLs you provide.
